tenantsTab.title: Manage buildings and residents

docsTab.title: Documents, messages and signatures

tasksTab.title: Project tasks

wizard.noBuildings: You may continue without adding addresses — the project will be created empty and you can add buildings later.
wizard.consentTargetHint: Defaulted from the project type (~66% per the 2023 reform). You can override it.

milestones.title: Intermediate targets
milestones.hint: Staged targets to track signature-collection progress (e.g. 25% → 50% → target). Each must be at or below the consent target.
milestones.label: Label
milestones.errorRange: Each intermediate target must be a whole number between 1 and 100.
milestones.errorOverTarget: An intermediate target cannot exceed the consent target.
milestones.errorDuplicate: Each intermediate target must be unique.

wizard.singleBuildingHint: Tama 38/1 (strengthening) covers a single building — owners stay in place.
wizard.twoBuildingHint: Tama 38/2 (demolish-rebuild) supports one or two buildings.
wizard.minimalCreateHint: A name and a type are all you need to create a project. Everything else — buildings, sections and units — can be added later, at any time.

section.residentialHint: Residential section — units are measured by rooms and floors.
section.officeHint: Office section — units are measured by area (sqm), not rooms.
section.retailHint: Retail section — units are measured by area (sqm). Usually a single floor.
section.mixedHint: Mixed-use section — combine residential, retail and office. Add a section per use.
section.mixedMultiSectionHint: A real mixed-use building = two or more sections of different kinds (e.g. retail on the ground floor and residential above).

review.noBuildings: No buildings — the project will be created basic. You can add buildings after creation.

validation.stepBlocked: Fill all required fields in this step before moving on

imports.storageUnavailable: Storage is temporarily unavailable. Retry shortly.
imports.mimeNotAllowed: File type not allowed. Import accepts .xlsx and .xls only.

imports.cancelConfirm: Cancel the import? You cannot cancel an already-finished import.

field.dryRunHint: In dry-run mode the system analyzes + validates the file but doesn't persist owners / apartments.

ownerships.title: Ownership shares
ownerships.hint: All shares must sum to exactly 100%. Empty list = clear all ownerships.
ownerships.renterHint: A renter does not sign and is not counted toward the 100% ownership; their share is always 0.
ownerships.emptyRows: No active ownerships. Click "Add row" to add one.
ownerships.sumMustBe100: Owner shares must sum to exactly 100 (renters excluded), or clear all by removing every owner.
ownerships.duplicate: The same owner cannot appear twice.
ownerships.serverSumInvalid: Server rejected the shares: invalid sum. Confirm 100%.

apartments.empty: No apartments in this building yet. Click "Add Apartment".
apartments.archiveConfirm: After archiving the apartment will be hidden. Continue?
apartments.statusHint: Update the signature-collection stage for this apartment. The change is audited.
apartments.ownershipsHint: Atomic share assignment per D.25 — active shares sum to 100% or 0.

signatureRequests.createHint: Pick a document and an owner to generate a single-use signing link (valid 7 days). The link is emailed to the resident and exposed as a WhatsApp deep-link when a phone number is on file.
signatureRequests.createdHint: Copy the signing link and send it to the resident via your preferred channel (WhatsApp / email). The link is single-use and valid for 7 days.
signatureRequests.signUrlWarning: This link contains a bearer token. Do not share publicly. If leaked, cancel the request and create a new one.
signatureRequests.pendingExists: A pending request already exists for this document and owner.
signatureRequests.storageUnavailable: Storage is currently unavailable. Try again shortly.
signatureRequests.forbidden: You are not allowed to create signature requests.
signatureRequests.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? The link will become invalid immediately.
signatureRequests.alreadySigned: Request already signed; cannot be cancelled.
signatureRequests.copyLinkHint: For manual delivery to an owner with no phone (WhatsApp / email / paper). Note: generating the link regenerates it — the previously sent link will stop working.
signatureRequests.copyLinkConfirm: A new signing link was copied to the clipboard. The previous link is no longer valid.
signatureRequests.copyLinkNotPending: A link can only be generated for a pending request.
signatureRequests.copyLinkFailed: Failed to generate the signing link.
signatureRequests.downloadSignedFailed: Failed to download the signed document.

sign.invalidBody: This signing link is no longer available. It may have expired, been signed, or been cancelled. Contact your project manager for a new link.
sign.invalidRecoveryHint: You can log in to the resident portal and send yourself a fresh signing link.
sign.invalidRecoveryCta: Log in to the portal to get a new link
sign.invalidContactManager: If you can't log in, contact your project manager.
sign.doneBody: Thank you. The signature has been saved. You can close this window.

sign.errorTooLarge: Signature is too large. Try a simpler signature.

dashboard.title: Provider Admin
dashboard.hint: Cross-tenant observer access. Every request adds a row to the Provider audit log.

onboard.title: Create a new tenant
onboard.hint: Create a new organization and invite its first Manager. The manager gets an email invite link and sets their own password.

tenantDetail.sampleOwnersHint: Up to 5 most-recent owners. Name and phone are masked server-side (•••••••XX / •••••XXXX); national_id never crosses the wire.

suspension.title: Tenant access control
suspension.activeHint: Tenant is active. Suspending freezes login for all of the tenant's users (reversible).
suspension.suspendConfirm: Suspending freezes login immediately for all users and residents. Reversible (does not delete data).
suspension.notePlaceholder: Reason for suspension — shown in the console
suspension.reactivateConfirm: Reactivate this tenant? New logins will be allowed again (existing sessions stay revoked).
suspension.reasonRequired: An access reason is required for this action.

audit.title: Cross-tenant audit search
audit.hint: Every search must specify a tenant id OR a date window of at most 31 days (Audit v1.1 SA-4). Every action is recorded.
audit.empty: No results for the current filters.
audit.errorSa4: Enter a tenant id, or a date range of at most 31 days.
audit.errorFromAfterTo: From-date must be on or before the to-date.

selfAudit.title: My activity
selfAudit.hint: Your own action log — what you accessed, when, and with what reason. Every cross-tenant access of yours is recorded here (B-PROVIDER-2). Viewing this is itself audited.
selfAudit.loadFailed: Failed to load your activity log.
selfAudit.empty: No records for the current filters.
selfAudit.errorFromAfterTo: From-date must be on or before the to-date.

systemHealth.title: System health — detailed view
systemHealth.hint: Live gauges for the job queue, DB pools, and R2 storage. Read-only. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.

capabilities.title: Permissions
capabilities.hint: Choose this agent's permissions. The default is least-privilege; grant only what's needed.

capabilities.presetManager: A Manager holds all permissions — nothing to configure.
capabilities.presetViewer: A Viewer is read-only with masked PII. No edit permissions.
capabilities.agentOnly: Permissions can only be set for agents.
